say:2:1029765001:1.text: Thanks to you all, the blacksmiths here have been busier than ever!
say:2:1029765001:1.source_cn: 嚯嚯嚯，托你们的福，这些日子铁匠们可是忙得团团转！

say:3:1029765002:1.text: Shops and tourists everywhere—it's almost like festival season again!
say:3:1029765002:1.source_cn: 到处都是商铺和游客，比祭典那会儿都不差多少！

say:4:1029765003:1.text: No kidding. My inn's been overflowing with guests every night!
say:4:1029765003:1.source_cn: 可不是，旅馆的客人也是一拨接着一拨，天天客满啊！

say:5:1029765004:1.text: But I've been hearing complaints from some of them, mostly about how much trouble the travel is.
say:5:1029765004:1.source_cn: 只不过我听着客人们聊天，发现里头有不少人都在抱怨，说路...

choice_prompt:6:1029765004.text: But I've been hearing complaints from some of them, mostly about how much trouble the travel is.
choice_prompt:6:1029765004.source_cn: 只不过我听着客人们聊天，发现里头有不少人都在抱怨，说路上太麻烦了。

say:7:1029765005:1.text: Some of them are traders who came to make deliveries.
say:7:1029765005:1.source_cn: 嗯，来旅店住宿的不仅是游客，有不少都是送货的商人。

say:8:1029765006:1.text: Those Mauler traders, for instance, said they bought weapon parts here, but then had to double back through Holistone.
say:8:1029765006:1.source_cn: 那些蛮血商人说，他们在这边采购了武器零件什么的，总得回...

say:9:1029765007:1.text: That's a detour, and with Holistone's strict inspections, all that back-and-forth really eats into their time.
say:9:1029765007:1.source_cn: 绕路不说，圣石镇那边的审查又特别严格，一来一回浪费不少时间。

say:10:1029765008:1.text: Exactly. I talked with Rodrigo, and Cedartown's been getting similar complaints and petitions.
say:10:1029765008:1.source_cn: 是啊，和罗德里戈聊了聊，发现雪松镇这边类似的抱怨和请愿...

say:11:1029765009:1.text: They all want a direct route between Cedartown and the Ashen Wastes, which would greatly benefit traders from the Uru Clan.
say:11:1029765009:1.source_cn: 他们都希望能让雪松镇与荒角沙漠——乌尔氏族的人直接往来。

say:12:1029765010:1.text: If that happens, we'll probably see more Mauler tourists, too.
say:12:1029765010:1.source_cn: 要是能建立直接往来的通道，估计蛮血的游客也会增加不少。

say:13:1029765011:1.text: Ugh, I'm not fond of those brawny brawlers, but I'll admit—they know how to feast and make noise.
say:13:1029765011:1.source_cn: 哼，我是不喜欢那些只会打架的笨蛋，不过嘛，他们吃喝玩乐...

say:14:1029765012:1.text: And my hot spring's got temps no one dares touch—perfect for them!
say:14:1029765012:1.source_cn: 我的温泉里还有没人敢挑战的超高温，最适合那帮笨蛋的厚皮毛了！

say:17:1029765013:0.text: Sounds like a solid idea. I just looked over the map—routes and goods both check out.
say:17:1029765013:0.source_cn: 很好的想法，我刚刚看了看地图，路线和商品都能保证。

say:18:1029765014:0.text: We just need permits from both sides, and our current trade station setup can handle the rest.
say:18:1029765014:0.source_cn: 只需要取得两个地方的许可，用现有的贸易站就完全能够实行了。

choice_prompt:19:1029765014.text: We just need permits from both sides, and our current trade station setup can handle the rest.
choice_prompt:19:1029765014.source_cn: 只需要取得两个地方的许可，用现有的贸易站就完全能够实行了。

say:20:1029765015:0.text: No time to waste. Let's go.
say:20:1029765015:0.source_cn: 嗯，事不宜迟，我们快出发吧。

choice:19:0:1.text: Let's head to the Uru Clan.
choice:19:0:1.male: Let's head to the Uru Clan.
choice:19:0:1.female: Let's head to the Uru Clan.
